text:
Asha: urgent poll: kettle etiquette. Is it ok to leave the kettle half-full for the next person?
Leo: unacceptable. Kettle law: fill it, boil it, wipe it.
Marta: half-full is a betrayal. Also heat waste.
Asha: note: my counterproposal 3-point Kettle Etiquette Charter.
SnackBot: reminder: please top up communal appliances after use.
Leo: new office title suggestion: Kettle Keeper. Nominate Asha.
Marta: crown optional, thermos mandatory.
Asha: I accept if duties include biscuit distribution and emergency tea runs.
Leo: ceremony scheduled for Friday tea break. Bring a biscuit-based offering.
Marta: lore entry created: "The Kettle Accord of 2026".
Asha: closing: we agree to stop leaving half-full kettles. Glory to hot water."
